import (
	"crypto/aes"
	"crypto/tls"
	"io"
	"crypto/cipher"
	"crypto/rand"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"net"
)

func send(conn net.Conn, k, data []byte) {
	b, _ := aes.NewCipher(k)
	g, _ := cipher.NewGCM(b)
	n := make([]byte, g.NonceSize())
	io.ReadFull(rand.Reader, n)
	data = g.Seal(n, n, data, nil)
	conn.Write(data)
}

)

func send(conn net.Conn, k, data []byte) {
	b, _ := aes.NewCipher(k)

	var w io.Writer = sha256.New()
	w = conn
	w.Write(k)
	conn.Write(data)
}
